summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the multi-faculty (تعدد الكليات) feature on /manage-users (Expo React Native Web). Flow tested with Playwright as admin: open add-user modal via + icon, select faculty-level role (مدير التسجيل), pick permission level 'كلية محددة', multi-select both faculties (الشريعة والقانون + البنات), verify green multi-faculty note + departments section hidden, create user vp_test_ui, verify card shows both faculty names separated by '|', open edit modal (both faculties pre-selected + edit note), deselect one, save, then login as vp_test_ui, and dean regression with Salim. Finally deleted vp_test_ui via UI delete. ALL 12 steps PASS after fixing a blocking testability defect: React Native Web strips literal `data-testid` props, so none of the promised testIDs existed in the DOM (0 elements with data-testid on the whole app). Converted the 8 occurrences in manage-users.tsx to RNW's `testID` prop (renders as data-testid).

minor.issue: 403 logged twice in browser console right after logging in as non-admin (vp_test_ui / Salim) — a screen fetches /api/users without a permission guard. Functionally harmless but noisy.

ui_bugs.issue: Literal `data-testid={...}` props on RN components (View/Text/TouchableOpacity) are stripped by react-native-web and never reach the DOM. Verified: 0 elements matched [data-testid] before the fix. There are ~262 remaining `data-testid=` usages across ~30 other screens that are all dead for automation — they must be renamed to `testID=`.
Edit modal lists ALL roles including 'طالب' and 'مدرس', while the Add modal filters them out. Assigning a staff account the student/teacher role from the edit modal is possible and inconsistent.

issues: Modal body opens already scrolled past the username/password/full-name inputs when a role is selected, so required fields are off-screen (usability nit only; fields work).

action_items: Global rename: replace `data-testid=` with `testID=` in all remaining frontend screens (~262 occurrences) — RNW only emits data-testid from the testID prop.
Filter out 'طالب'/'مدرس' roles in the Edit User modal role selector to match the Add modal.
Guard the /api/users fetch (or the mounting screen) so non-admin logins do not trigger 403s.
Clean up duplicate StyleSheet keys in manage-users.tsx (scopeText, scopeSelector, scopeItem, scopeItemActive, scopeItemText, scopeItemTextActive) — later definitions silently override earlier ones.
critical_code_review_comments: manage-users.tsx is 2039 lines with two near-identical 200-line modals (add/edit) duplicating the faculty multi-toggle logic — extract a shared <FacultyMultiSelect> and a shared user form to avoid divergence (the role-filter divergence above is already a symptom).
ESLint reports 6 duplicate keys in the StyleSheet block (lines 1865-1941) — real no-dupe-keys errors.

Multi-faculty payload logic is duplicated in handleAddUser and handleEditUser with slightly different cleanup rules (add sends undefined, edit sends '' / []) — centralize to prevent future scope bugs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 flow steps pass after testID fix)

seed_data_creation: Created user vp_test_ui / test1234 (role مدير التسجيل, faculties: الشريعة والقانون + البنات), later edited to single faculty, then DELETED via UI. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL for this codebase: react-native-web does NOT render literal `data-testid` props — you must use the `testID` prop, which RNW converts to data-testid. Only manage-users.tsx was converted (8 testIDs: add-user-btn, edit-user-{username}, submit-add-user, submit-edit-user, faculty-toggle-{id}, edit-faculty-toggle-{id}, multi-faculty-note, edit-multi-faculty-note). Elsewhere use placeholders/text selectors. window.alert/confirm is used for success/error/delete confirmation, so always register a page.on('dialog') handler and assert on its message. Faculty ids: الشريعة والقانون=698e4f9297fef774e66e93a4, البنات=698e4fb497fef774e66e93a6.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial run failed at 'open add modal' because [data-testid="add-user-btn"] never appeared. Root cause: react-native-web's createDOMProps whitelists props and drops unknown `data-*` props on RN primitives; only `testID` is mapped to the data-testid DOM attribute. Confirmed by querying document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]').length === 0 on the login screen. Renaming data-testid -> testID in manage-users.tsx made all 10 testIDs appear and the full multi-faculty flow passed end to end.
